one_liner: Squarespace has a broad REST Commerce API with per-site API keys (paid Commerce Advanced plan) and OAuth 2.0 (manual client review), plus an official remote MCP server; buildable with friction.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow, but client credentials are issued only after a manual request/review (form), so not self-serve. API keys are self-generated per site in Developer API Keys and are the only self-serve method. Webhook Subscriptions API reportedly OAuth-only.
access_notes: OAuth client_id/secret issued only after Squarespace reviews the registration. Self-serve API keys require a paid Commerce Advanced plan for Orders, Inventory and Transactions. OAuth use is tied to Squarespace Extensions.
blocker_notes: Multi-user OAuth needs manual Squarespace approval of the OAuth client. Testing with API keys needs a paid Commerce Advanced site.

evidence.quote: If you'd like to develop a new Extension, start the OAuth client process by filling out [this form](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/en-us/requests/new?ticket_form_id=28554433855373).
**Orders**, **Inventory**, and **Transactions** are only available in the Commerce Advanced plan.
With [Squarespace's Commerce Advanced](https://www.squarespace.com/pricing) plan, you can develop a custom application for a Squarespace merchant site.
All Commerce APIs are built on HTTPS and designed with REST principles in mind.
The Squarespace MCP server is a remote server: your client connects to it over HTTPS, and there's nothing to install.
The Squarespace MCP server connects AI assistants, like Claude and ChatGPT, to Squarespace tools using Model Context Protocol (MCP).
